alt: 年長男子抬手訓話並揮手拒絕建議，年輕志工拿著組裝圖耐心聽著。
scene_prompt: 倚老賣老 is a negative idiom for an older person who relies on age and experience to act superior and look down on others. In a modern community workshop, a gray-haired older man confidently lectures younger volunteers with a raised finger and dismissive expression, insisting he knows best while waving away their sensible suggestion for assembling a bookshelf. The younger people hold a clear simple assembly diagram and look patient but unconvinced; the older man's age-based manner is the source of his superiority. Avoid implying all elderly people act this way. Natural anatomy, exactly two arms and legs each, gestures connected, bookshelf parts and tools safely supported on workbench, no danger, sensible perspective.
style_prompt: Create ONE original child-friendly picture-book illustration, landscape 3:2, delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, natural muted colors. No text, logos or watermark.
